newsitem.title: UK: C&W up on HK surge, BT news. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: C&W up on HK surge, BT news. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Plc jumped on Friday on the back of a surge in Hong Kong stocks overnight coupled with a profit warning from MCI group, BT's merger partner (corrects name of the company issuing the profit warning).
The shares rose 16p to 577-1/2p by 0913 GMT.
Hong Kong's Hang Seng index leapt 386 points or 2.6 percent to 15,225.29 overnight, boosting the Hong Kong exposed stock.
The telecoms company was also marked higher on the back of a profit warning from MCI which left shares in its merger partner BT reeling, dealers said.
BT fell 32p to 445-1/2p as analysts prepared to cut earnings estimates for the British group.
"The shares are up on the back of the BT news and of course it's benefiting a great deal from the Hang Seng as Cable is very much a Hong Kong stock."
